covers: device profiles reject a shared listener and non-loopback endpoint
personal identity and space persist across storage reopen and product restart
school login verifies the real password and revocation invalidates existing sessions
a revoked member cannot log in again with an old session, but the original account and identity survive regrant
an administrator can revoke one lost client connection without revoking the member
the learning owner creates one course-free activity, replays the same request identity, rejects changed input and hides other members' activities
activity close survives storage reopen and reopen returns to the list
client proof grants bind the school member and capabilities, and logout/revocation are independent
production daemon exposes the learning API, keeps the activity after restart and rejects forged identity headers
POST /api/learning/manage/connection returns {revoked:true} after an administrator revokes a client connection
one installed client switches personal and school through the real school approval page
revoking through the client removes the local grant; the school space is no longer offered and proxied access returns 403
both business owners restore the original activity and fence old school sessions after recovery takeover

limitations: Both environments ran on the same Apple Silicon Mac; cross-machine networking is not covered by this issue.
